judgment.rationale: Both SFIs sit in Grade R (rank 0) Emergent Reading, but in different terms: the second SFI is Grade R Term 2, Sub-strand 'Emergent reading' ('Understands that print communicates meaning. The shared 'own name / names' wording is not merely repeated phrasing; the later statement decomposes the known name-word into named letters. The only other nomination signals (shared ancestors, the single shared LC tag 'phonics', zero rank gap, the trigram 'ent', same source page) are not semantic grounds for direction. judgment.rationale: Both are Grade R, Term 3, Listening and Speaking (Oral) Skill bullets under the same sub-strand 'Daily activities in all areas of Language and other subjects' (identical rank 0 coordinate and same Term, same source page/table cell). 'Listens attentively to questions and gives answers' (LCs: listens attentively to questions; gives answers to questions) is responsive question-answer oral interaction, while 'Tells stories and retells other children's stories in own words' (LCs: tells stories; retells other children's stories in own words) is extended narrative production and retelling. These are substantively coherent, complementary oral-language capabilities (attentive listening and spoken response supporting and accompanying oral narrative), but the evidence shows no expanded-capability or dependency relationship in either direction, and both sit in the same Term so same-rank developmental direction is unsupported. Source evidence for both endpoints and LC evidence for the second endpoint are truncated, so finer-grained sequencing detail is not available; the shared conceptual coherence is nonetheless clear from the printed statements.
